name: jmove skill (for AI agents)
title_zh: 搬完文件顺手把全项目 import 改对的命令行工具
tagline_zh: 重命名一个文件，编辑器只会帮你改一半引用，剩下的运行时才炸。
tagline_en: Rename a file and your editor only fixes half the references; the rest blow up at runtime. This CLI dry-runs.
desc_en: Move source files, keep every import intact — fast CLI refactoring for TS/JS (Java, Python, Go planned). Dry-run, atomic apply, --json for AI agents.
why_zh: 先算后写：dry-run 把改动全摊开给你看，确认才落盘，中途失败不会留下半改状态。
why_en: Compute then commit: dry-run shows every edit, nothing is written until you approve, and a failed apply never leaves a.
limit_zh: 目前只覆盖 TS/JS，Java、Python、Go 还在计划里；动态拼接的 import 路径它认不出来，得手动补。
limit_en: TS/JS only for now — Java, Python and Go are still planned. Dynamically constructed import paths won't be detected; fix those by hand.
title_en: Move source files and fix every import in one CLI pass
